title: Permissions capture
inspection: six evenly spaced frames visually reviewed
viewport: mobile portrait; encoded pixel dimensions are not device-point dimensions
observations: A blue-purple gradient supports a notification pre-prompt, followed by the system notification alert. A luminous arrow points toward the prompt area. Large white username text and a keyboard follow, then a glowing circular profile-photo control with a skip option.
learning_candidate: Use one visual language across permissions and profile setup; an attention cue toward consent is a pattern to evaluate, not automatically copy.
